name: world
timings: SELECT CAST(a.rowid AS TEXT) source_row FROM temp.landscape_region_index i CROSS JOIN atlas_landscape a ON a.rowid=i.id WHERE a.campaign_id=? AND i.max_x>=? AND i.min_x<=? AND i.max_y>=? AND i.min_y<=? AND json_extract(a.payload,'$.kind')!='patch' ORDER BY CASE WHEN json_extract(a.payload,'$.kind')='reference' THEN 0 WHEN json_extract(a.payload,'$.line.overSymbols')=1 THEN 3 WHEN json_extract(a.payload,'$.line') IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 2 END,CAST(json_extract(a.payload,'$.resolution') AS REAL) DESC,coalesce(json_extract(a.payload,'$.order'),0),a.rowid

SELECT CAST(a.rowid AS TEXT) source_row,a.payload,a.min_x,a.max_x,a.min_y,a.max_y,json_extract(l.payload,'$.name') location_name,l.trashed FROM json_each(?) ids CROSS JOIN atlas_landscape a ON a.rowid=ids.value LEFT JOIN location l ON l.campaign_id=a.campaign_id AND l.id=json_extract(a.payload,'$.locationId') WHERE a.campaign_id=? ORDER BY CAST(ids.key AS INTEGER)

SELECT b.*,e.x extent_x,e.y extent_y,e.width extent_width,e.height extent_height,s.id scope_id,s.name scope_name
   FROM atlas_binding b LEFT JOIN temp.region_extent e ON b.kind='dungeon' AND e.scope=b.owner_id AND e.floor=CASE WHEN b.owner_id=? THEN ? ELSE 'ground' END
   LEFT JOIN scope s ON b.kind='dungeon' AND s.campaign_id=b.campaign_id AND s.id=b.owner_id
   WHERE b.campaign_id=? ORDER BY CASE b.kind WHEN 'city' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,b.rowid

SELECT id,scope_id scopeId,name,source_elevation sourceElevation FROM drawing_floor f WHERE campaign_id=? AND scope_id=? AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM drawing_hidden h WHERE h.campaign_id=f.campaign_id AND h.id=f.id AND h.scope_id=f.scope_id AND h.kind='floor' AND h.hidden=1)
SELECT payload FROM atlas_landscape WHERE campaign_id=? AND json_valid(payload) AND json_extract(payload,'$.terrainSettings') IS NOT NULL
